object: Historical control import: for J=[[0,1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,-2]], examine the universal sentence rank(P^T J P/2)>=2 implies that P^T J P/2 is indefinite. This is an already-refuted sentence, not a new proposed RH solution.

next_test: Replay the existing exact_scope_check.py and register its scoped result with the audit as immutable evidence.
stop_condition: Stop this exact universal claim on a rank-two negative-definite witness; preserve narrower arithmetic realization questions.

Exhibit its definite quadratic form, with an indefinite positive control.
